title: Testing the AdS/CFT Correspondence Through Thermodynamic Geometry of Nonlinear Electrodynamics AdS Black Holes with Generalized Entropies
summary: We investigate the thermodynamics and thermodynamic geometry of several Anti--de Sitter black hole solutions arising from nonlinear electromagnetic theories, namely the ModMax, nonlinear electrodynamics (NED), and Euler--Heisenberg AdS black holes, together with their holographically dual conformal field theory (CFT) descriptions. The analysis is carried out within three entropy frameworks: the standard Bekenstein--Hawking entropy and the generalized Rényi and Kaniadakis entropies.
